task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .
Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves everything in one file, with its pictures. Choose this one.
saves your tree as a family tree file, without pictures. Use it only for a program that cannot read GEDZIP.

step.cmd: If you chose , choose a version.

info.p: The box named offers and . Choose the first unless a program you use is old.

step.cmd: When Windows asks where to put the file, choose a folder you will remember.

info.p: When you have saved, look in the folder to check that the copy is there.

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new one after you add a lot. Keep one on another drive too.
result.note: If you opened a file from another program, saves your changes to that file. To leave the original alone, open a copy.
